title: Titles containing Winter
statementMd:
Find books with `Winter` in the title.

Expected columns: `title`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title FROM books WHERE title LIKE '%Winter%';
```
